# SmartHomeBlindControl

**Class:** `SmartHomeBlindControl` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A blind's position, tilt and presets

## Overview

@brief Blind/shade control widget A picture of the blind in its window, Open / Stop / Close, a position slider, an optional tilt slider and buttons for the presets.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

SmartHomeBlindControl(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit SmartHomeBlindControl(const std::string& identifier);
